messages:
rick_ops: HyperFreight pinged back on H100 tranche. They can do a split: 28 air-priority now, remainder sea in 5-7 weeks if we accept forwarder premium and a 21-day deposit hold.
leah_fin: How big is the premium? need $ numbers asap to sign deposit.
dan_hyperfreight: Dan (HyperFreight): Air premium is +10% per unit (air tariff + expedited handling). We can also add a conditional RMA voucher up to 4% for DOA (courier + refurb credit) if Redwood signs deposit. AWB tentative: HF-AW-770 (air).
emma_procure: 28 helps the west coast cluster. Ops: can you split 18 -> us-west pool, 10 -> us-east? any constraints on on-site swaps?
rick_ops: yes split OK. ops prefers on-arrival replacement for DOA >2%. voucher acceptable if vendor guarantees depot photo evidence + 24h triage window in SLA. also require KMS whitelist notice 48h prior to handoff.
dan_hyperfreight: We can add photo-evidence clause and 24h triage SLA. Immediate replacement beyond 4% DOA is tough without cost; happy to expedite at cost if above threshold. We'll include KMS clause.
leah_fin: Finance: approve deposit up to $200k for the lot and premium line for up to +10%. Flag: if remainder gets repriced (vendor ad-hoc >+10%), procurement will review.
emma_procure: put in procurement action: confirm which serial ranges go to west vs east. also request vendor manifest with per-serial depot tags so we can reconcile on arrival.
ship-bot: Required docs checklist: AWB, commercial invoice, packing list, HS 8471.90, thermal packaging cert for sea, manifest with serial ranges.
dan_hyperfreight: Will send draft RMA + voucher template in 6-8h and lock AWB HF-AW-770 once deposit ack'd. Sea hold scheduled per standard window.
rick_ops: Action items: emma to send customs PO & per-pool delivery addresses; leah to wire deposit; i'll confirm on-call depot triage capacity for 24h SLA. Need AWB numbers in 36h.
leah_fin: I'll authorise the wire once RMA draft reviewed. finance wants voucher template included before wire.
dan_hyperfreight: Understood. Draft RMA + voucher attached in reply thread when ready. Will also include depot photo checklist and shipping ETA. :thumbsup:
rick_ops: thanks. closing loop after we have the RMA and AWB confirmed.
